people.name: Cornelius
people.line: Centurion, first Gentile convert to Christianity

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.
translations.bsb: As Peter was about to enter, Cornelius met him and fell at his feet to worship him.
translations.kjv: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped
translations.asv: And when it came to pass that Peter entered, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.
